learning_objective: 🎯 Uncover the secrets of how light travels, why shadows change size, and how mirrors create magical reflections!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Light is the fastest thing in the universe, but it has one strict rule: it only travels in perfectly straight lines! It cannot bend around corners, which is why you cannot see what is hidden behind a solid brick wall.
When an opaque object blocks the path of light, it creates a dark patch behind it called a shadow. The size of your shadow changes throughout the day depending on where the Sun is in the sky!

When light hits a smooth, shiny surface like a mirror or a calm lake, it bounces right back at you! This bouncing of light is called reflection, and it is the exact reason you can see your own smiling face in the mirror.

fun_activity.title: 🔦 The Shadow Puppet Theater
fun_activity.instructions: Turn off the lights in your room and point a flashlight at a blank wall. Use your hands to block the light and create fun animal shapes like a barking dog or a flying bird, and see how moving your hands closer makes the shadows huge!

quick_recap: ⭐ Light always travels in straight lines and helps us see luminous objects.
⭐ Shadows are formed when an opaque object blocks a source of light.
⭐ Reflection occurs when light bounces off a smooth, shiny surface like a mirror.
